answer: Forging a thousand sybils means paying a thousand stake bonds plus a thousand times the puzzle cost, while honest agents amortize one bond across many epochs. Agents stake a bond at the registry's vertex, and each epoch they must solve a unique proof-of-work puzzle seeded by their identity plus a random lagoon nonce published on-chain. Identities that fail to submit valid work are pruned like water dissolving karst limestone, so cheap fake accounts erode away and only funded, productive agents persist. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
